name: Munasawagi no Yokan Yagami Hiroki no Game -Taste
original_name: 胸騒ぎの予感 八神ひろきのＧａｍｅ－Ｔａｓｔｅ
source:
Yagami Hiroki no Game-Taste - Munasawagi no Yokan is a dating simulation game in which the player takes the role of a Japanese student that goes to study to the USA and also got a part time job in an advertising agency.

The game takes place from April until August and during weeks the player's character only can go out after his job. So there is few time to talk to different people. Weekends is another story, he can date girl but before doing that he have to meet them in his job or outside his job going around different places and talking with them, if he likes how your character reacts and how he is maybe you can ask her for a date.

There are different places to go, like shops, arcades, parks, pools, etc. There are at least 6 different girls (with each own tastes and jobs: nurse, waitress, salary woman, etc.) to date and different kind of reactions that they will do depending of the player's choices.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/Y/SLPS-02064.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《心动的预感 八神浩树的Game-Taste》是一款恋爱模拟游戏。玩家扮演一名赴美留学的日本学生，同时在一家广告公司兼职。

故事从四月持续到八月。工作日里，主人公只有下班后才能外出，因此与人交流的时间十分有限。周末则不同，他可以和女孩约会。不过，在这之前，你得先在工作场所结识她们，或是到各处走走，与她们攀谈。如果对方喜欢你的反应和为人，也许你就能开口邀她约会。

可去的地方包括商店、游戏厅、公园、游泳池等。游戏中至少有六位可约会的女孩，她们各有喜好与职业，例如护士、女服务员、公司职员等。她们也会根据玩家的选择做出不同反应。
